grams: The weight value in grams. Must be in the range `[0, 100000]`.
kcal: Energy burned during an activity, measured in kilocalories. Must be in the range `[0, 1000000]`.
day: Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't significant.
minutes: Total duration in minutes of a sleep stage.
month: Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a month and day.
seconds: Seconds of a minute. Must be greater than or equal to 0 and typically must be less than or equal to 59. An API may allow the value 60 if it allows leap-seconds.
hours: Hours of a day in 24 hour format. Must be greater than or equal to 0 and typically must be less than or equal to 23. An API may choose to allow the value "24:00:00" for scenarios like business closing time.
year: Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without a year.
nanos: Fractions of seconds, in nanoseconds. Must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 999,999,999.
pageSize: The maximum number of data points to return. If unspecified, at most 1440 data points will be returned. The maximum page size is 10000; values above that will be truncated accordingly.
windowSizeDays: Aggregation window size, in number of days. Defaults to 1 if not specified. If the requested range is not an exact multiple of `window_size_days`, the final bucket chronologically will be truncated at the upper endpoint of the range and will cover a duration shorter than `window_size_days`.
strokeCountSum: Total number of swim strokes in the interval.
weightGrams: Weight of a user in grams. Must be in the range `[0, 1000000]`.
bloodGlucoseMilligramsPerDeciliter: Blood glucose level concentration in mg/dL. Must be in the range `[0, 900]`.
gainMillimeters: Altitude gain in millimeters over the observed interval. Must be in the range `[-1000000000, 1000000000]`.
batteryLevel: The battery level of the device.
status: The HTTP status code, such as 200 or 404.
averageHeartRateVariabilityMilliseconds: A user's average heart rate variability calculated using the root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) in times between heartbeats.
entropy: The Shanon entropy of heartbeat intervals. Entropy quantifies randomness or disorder in a system. High entropy indicates high HRV. Entropy is measured from the histogram of time interval between successive heart beats values measured during sleep.
deepSleepRootMeanSquareOfSuccessiveDiffe: The root mean square of successive differences (RMSSD) value during deep sleep.
heightMillimeters: Height of the user in millimeters. Must be in the range `[0, 3000]`.
avgStrideLengthMillimeters: Stride length is a measure of the distance covered by a single stride
avgVerticalOscillationMillimeters: Distance off the ground your center of mass moves with each stride while running
avgCadenceStepsPerMinute: Cadence is a measure of the frequency of your foot strikes. Steps / min in real time during workout.
temperatureCelsiusMin: Minimum core body temperature in Celsius.
temperatureCelsiusMax: Maximum core body temperature in Celsius.
temperatureCelsiusAvg: Average core body temperature in Celsius.
activeMinutesSum: Number of whole minutes spent in activity.
maxBeatsPerMinute: Maximum heart rate for this zone in beats per minute.
minBeatsPerMinute: Minimum heart rate for this zone in beats per minute.
amount: Amount of food consumed, fractional values are supported.
rateMin: Minimum value of run VO2 max in the interval..
rateMax: Maximum value of run VO2 max in the interval.
rateAvg: Average value of run VO2 max in the interval.
highFrequencyPower: The power in interbeat interval fluctuations within the high frequency band (0.15 Hz - 0.4 Hz).
lowFrequencyPower: The power in interbeat interval fluctuations within the low frequency band (0.04 Hz - 0.15 Hz).
beatsPerMinute: The beats-per-minute value extrapolated from the time before the following heart beat. This is calculated as 60000 / rr, where rr is the gap between heart beats in milliseconds (IBI - Interbeat Interval).
bloodGlucoseMilligramsPerDeciliterAvg: Average blood glucose level in mg/dL.
standardDeviationMilliseconds: The standard deviation of the heart rate variability measurement.
rootMeanSquareOfSuccessiveDifferencesMil: The root mean square of successive differences between normal heartbeats. This is a measure of heart rate variability used by Google Health. Must be in the range `[1, 200]`.
totalSize: The total number of subscribers matching the request.
activeZoneMinutes: Total active zone minutes for the exercise.
nightlyTemperatureCelsius: The user's nightly skin temperature. It is the mean of skin temperature samples taken from the user’s sleep.
relativeNightlyStddev30dCelsius: The standard deviation of the user’s relative nightly skin temperature (temperature - baseline) over the past 30 days.
baselineTemperatureCelsius: The user's baseline skin temperature. It is the median of the user's nightly skin temperature over the past 30 days.
gainMillimetersSum: Sum of the altitude gain in millimeters.
count: Number of steps in the recorded interval. Must be in the range `[0, 1000000]`.
beatsPerMinuteMin: The minimum heart rate value in the interval.
beatsPerMinuteMax: The maximum heart rate value in the interval.
samplingFrequencyHertz: The sampling frequency of waveform samples in hertz.
millivoltsScalingFactor: The factor by which to divide waveform samples to get voltage in millivolts: millivolts = waveform_sample / millivolts_scaling_factor.
beatsPerMinuteAvg: The average heart rate value in the interval.
leadNumber: The number of leads used for ECG reading.
millimetersSum: Sum of the distance in millimeters.
percentage: The oxygen saturation percentage. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
signalToNoise: How trustworthy the data is for the computation.
standardDeviation: Standard deviation of the respiratory rate during sleep.
gramsSum: The sum of the weight in grams.
averageHeartRateVariabilityMillisecondsM: The lower bound of the user's average heart rate variability personal range.
The upper bound of the user's average heart rate variability personal range.
vo2Max: VO2 max value measured as in ml consumed oxygen / kg of body weight / min. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
vo2MaxCovariance: The covariance of the VO2 max value.
activeMinutes: Number of whole minutes spent in activity.
runVo2Max: Run VO2 max value in ml/kg/min. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
averageSpeedMillimetersPerSecond: Average speed in millimeters per second.
averageHeartRateBeatsPerMinute: Average heart rate during the exercise.
totalSwimLengths: Number of full pool lengths completed during the exercise. Only present in the swimming exercises at the top level as in the summary of the whole exercise.
elevationGainMillimeters: Total elevation gain during the exercise.
steps: Total steps taken during the exercise.
caloriesKcal: Total calories burned by the user during the exercise.
distanceMillimeters: Total distance covered by the user during the exercise.
averagePaceSecondsPerMeter: Average pace in seconds per meter.
kcalSum: The sum of the energy in kilocalories.
embeddedLengthMax: Integer upper bound on the length of embedded payloads
multiplier: Value representing the multiplier used to compute the energy when using this serving instead of the default serving.
milliliters: Value representing the volume in milliliters. Must be in the range `[0, 100000]`.
strokeCount: Number of strokes in the lap.
autoRunningStrideLengthMm: The automatically calculated running stride length, in millimeters. The user must consent to the following access scope to access this field: - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.activity_and_fitness.readonly`
age: The age in years based on the user's birth date. Updates to this field are currently not supported.
userConfiguredWalkingStrideLengthMm: The user's user configured walking stride length, in millimeters. The user must consent to the following access scope to access this field: - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.activity_and_fitness.readonly`
userConfiguredRunningStrideLengthMm: The user's user configured running stride length, in millimeters. The user must consent to the following access scope to access this field: - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.activity_and_fitness.readonly`
autoWalkingStrideLengthMm: The automatically calculated walking stride length, in millimeters. The user must consent to the following access scope to access this field: - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.activity_and_fitness.readonly`
code: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.
standardDeviationPercentage: Standard deviation of the daily oxygen saturation averages from the past 7-30 days.
averagePercentage: The average value of the oxygen saturation samples during the sleep. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
upperBoundPercentage: The upper bound of the confidence interval of oxygen saturation samples during sleep. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
lowerBoundPercentage: The lower bound of the confidence interval of oxygen saturation samples during sleep. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
temperatureCelsius: The core body temperature in Celsius. Must be in the range `[0, 100]`.
millilitersSum: The sum of volume in milliliters.
poolLengthMillimeters: Pool length in millimeters. Only present in the swimming exercises.
millimeters: Distance in millimeters over the observed interval. Must be in the range `[0, 1000000000]`.
minutesInSleepPeriod: Delta between wake time and bedtime. It is the sum of all stages.
minutesAsleep: Total number of minutes asleep. For classic sleep it is the sum of ASLEEP stages (excluding AWAKE and RESTLESS). For "stages" sleep it is the sum of LIGHT, REM and DEEP stages (excluding AWAKE).
minutesAfterWakeUp: Minutes after wake up calculated by restlessness algorithm.
minutesToFallAsleep: Minutes to fall asleep calculated by restlessness algorithm.
minutesAwake: Total number of minutes awake. It is a sum of all AWAKE stages.
